response: According to the Medicaid Demonstration in Florida, provider service networks (PSNs) do result in lower expenditures compared to HMOs and primary care case management. In fact, the data shows that PSNs generated slightly greater reductions in expenditures compared to HMOs, making them a promising model for delivering care to Medicaid enrollees. This suggests that PSNs can be an effective way to manage healthcare costs while providing quality care to Medicaid recipients in Florida.
